objects.name: Ruined keep ladder
objects.label: Climb into the ruined keep
objects.say: You climb the outside ladder, cross the wall, and climb down into the ruined keep.

objects.name: Ruined keep ladder
objects.label: Climb out of the ruined keep
objects.say: You climb the inside ladder, cross the wall, and climb down outside the ruined keep.

objects.name: Dragon Heart hatch
objects.label: Unlock and descend
objects.shut: The iron hatch is locked. Its keyhole is shaped like a flame around a heart.
objects.say: The Dragon-Heart Key turns. You descend without moving east or west, directly beneath the ruined keep.
objects.unlock: The Dragon-Heart Key turns and the main hatch unlocks. You descend directly beneath the ruined keep.
objects.examine: An iron hatch sunk into the keep's paving. It descends directly beneath this spot.

objects.noTool: It looks like I will need a pickaxe to strike the iron root seal.
objects.name: Iron root seal
objects.label: Tune
objects.say: You read the stresses in the old iron, strike the false note free, and tune the root seal. A hatch unlocks below.
objects.unlock: The iron root seal releases. The hatch to the echo chamber is now unlocked.
objects.done: The iron root holds a low, steady note.
objects.examine: Veins of iron run into the foundation like roots. A skilled miner could find the fault in their resonance.

objects.name: Retreat ladder
objects.label: Climb back to the ruined keep
objects.say: You climb the emergency ladder back into the ruined keep. The dungeon will wait until you are prepared.

objects.name: Echo stair
objects.label: Descend to the echo chamber
objects.shut: The iron root seal has not released this hatch.

objects.name: Echo seal
objects.label: Wake
objects.say: Magic crosses the seal. Three answers step out of different ages—venom, shadow, and ash. Survive all three.
objects.unlock: The last echo guardian falls. The hatch to the balance chamber is now unlocked.
objects.done: The echo seal is quiet. Its three answering shapes are gone.
objects.examine: Three broken spell-circles overlap here. Magic could make their echoes solid enough to fight.

objects.name: Retreat ladder
objects.label: Climb back to the ruined keep
objects.say: You follow the emergency shaft back to daylight.

objects.name: Balance stair
objects.label: Descend to the balance chamber
objects.shut: The echo guardians still bind this hatch.

objects.name: Crimson stone rune
objects.say: A slab in the wall hurls a crushing rock at the crimson rune.

objects.name: Verdant arrow rune
objects.say: An arrow snaps from the wall toward the verdant rune.

objects.name: Azure spell rune
objects.say: An azure bolt leaps from the wall into the spell rune.

objects.name: Retreat ladder
objects.label: Climb back to the ruined keep
objects.say: You retreat up the emergency shaft.

objects.name: Heart stair
objects.label: Descend to the Heart
objects.shut: The balance seal has not released the lowest hatch.

objects.noTool: It looks like I will need a tinderbox to light the war seal.
objects.name: War seal
objects.label: Ignite
objects.say: You feed the seal a clean spark. Gale, Keel, and Bramble form around the Heart: one heavy spell, one certain arrow, one staggering blow.
objects.done: The war seal is cold. Its guardians have been defeated.
objects.examine: A fire channel divides into three combat runes. It will demand several protection styles in quick succession.

objects.name: Dragon Heart
objects.label: Reset
objects.shut: The Heart throws your hand away. Its three war guardians still hold it out of balance.
objects.say: You turn the Heart through its broken beat, catch the returning pulse, and set it back into the old rhythm. A ladder unfolds all the way to the hatch above.
objects.done: The Dragon Heart beats slowly and evenly beneath the keep.
objects.examine: A knot of violet power held inside four iron rings. Its rhythm is dangerously uneven.

objects.name: Heart ladder
objects.label: Climb to the ruined keep
objects.say: The emergency ladder carries you straight up through all four floors to the hatch in the ruined keep.
